title: Add keyboard shortcut handler to RocketLoopApp
description: Add keyboard shortcuts to the running loop TUI: 'q' for graceful quit, 'p' for pause, 's' to skip current iteration.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing 'q' exits cleanly (stops loop, cleans up caffeinate, exits process)
Pressing 'p' pauses the loop and shows 'Paused' indicator
Pressing 's' skips to the next iteration
Keyboard shortcuts only work when in 'running' state

steps.details: In RocketLoopApp.tsx, import useInput from ink. Add: useInput((input, key) => { if (state !== 'running') return; if (input === 'q') handleQuit(); if (input === 'p') handlePause(); if (input === 's') handleSkip() })
async function handleQuit() { abortLoop(); // signal generator to stop; caffeinate.stop(caffProc); await writePartialLog(); process.exit(0) }
Add a paused state. When paused: set a pause flag that prevents the generator from advancing. Show a 'Paused — press p to resume' indicator overlay. Pressing p again clears the flag.
Implement skip by killing the current AI process (child process). The loop runner detects process exit and advances to the next iteration.

technicalNotes: useInput from ink captures all keyboard input in raw mode — ensure it's only active during the running state
For skip: store a reference to the current child process and call proc.kill() when s is pressed
